data.name: Devak
data.gender_notes: Devak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Devak is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Deva’, meaning 'god'. The suffix ‘k’ signifies ‘gift from god’. This name is given to a child who is believed to be a divine gift. The name Devak carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devak usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devak total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
